decisions.rationale: Chequing balance of $180,012 with seasoned history and no unusual deposits covers the $160,000 down payment and leaves about $20k for closing costs.
Panel appraiser value of $812,000 supports the $800,000 price, but the report is dated 20 March 2026 (76 days before review) and the policy gives no definition of recent.
Credit score of 545 is below the 600 minimum, although GDS (about 30%) and TDS (about 36%) are within limits.
